title: Manage Oasis Browser Profiles
description: Learn how to create, customize and manage Oasis browser profiles so you can separate your browsing among different use cases or people.
content:
When you use Oasis browser (available in both Free Agentic Browser and Enterprise Browser versions), all your data such as bookmarks, passwords and settings are stored in a "profile." Creating multiple profiles allows you to keep separate browsing data, themes or settings for different purposes, such as work and personal use. This guide walks you through the steps to create, customize and manage Oasis browser profiles.

Pro Tip

Profiles are especially useful for enterprise users who need to maintain separate browsing environments for different projects, clients, or security contexts. The Enterprise version includes additional profile management features for IT administrators.

Oasis Browser Versions

Free Agentic Browser

Personal productivity browser with profile management for individual users. Perfect for personal use, freelancers, and small teams.

Enterprise Browser

Advanced browser with enhanced profile management, centralized administration, and enterprise security features for organizations.

Table of Contents

  • Create a new profile
  • Customize a profile
  • Open an existing profile
  • Delete a profile
  • Use Sync with a new profile
  • Choose a profile at Oasis startup
  • Enterprise Profile Management
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Create a new profile

Want to start fresh with a new profile? Here's how:

  1. 1

    In the toolbar, click the account icon in the top-right corner of the browser window.

  2. 2

    Click Profiles, then + New profile. Oasis will launch a new instance to create your new profile, meaning you will see two Oasis icons in your taskbar or dock.

  3. 3

    Follow the on-screen prompts to set up your new profile. All of your changes will be saved automatically.

  4. 4

    When you're finished, close the tab or click Done editing.

Customize a profile

After setting up a profile, you can continue to personalize it by tweaking its name, theme and avatar.

Profile name

Give your profile a unique name to help you spot it easily. Profiles are listed alphabetically.

Profile theme

Pick a theme to give each profile a unique color scheme. This is especially useful if you have multiple profiles open at the same time.

Profile avatar

Choose an avatar that will help you identify your profile. You'll also see your avatar as a badge on the Oasis icon in your taskbar or dock.

To update your profile:

  1. 1

    In the toolbar, click the account icon.

  2. 2

    Click the name of your current profile.

  3. 3

    Click the edit icon in the top-right corner to edit your current profile. To edit a different profile, click Manage Profiles.

  4. 4

    Changes made to a profile's customization are saved automatically. When you're finished, close the tab or click Done editing.

Open an existing profile

Switching profiles is super simple:

  1. 1

    In the toolbar, click the account icon.

  2. 2

    Click the name of your current profile.

  3. 3

    From the dropdown, just pick the profile you want to open.

Delete a profile

If you no longer need a profile, you can delete it easily by following these steps:

  1. 1

    In the toolbar, click the account icon.

  2. 2

    Click the name of your current profile.

  3. 3

    Click the edit icon in the top-right corner to proceed with deleting your current profile. To delete a different profile, click Manage Profiles.

  4. 4

    At the bottom-right, click Delete.

  5. 5

    Since deleting a profile is permanent, you can review the data that will be deleted, and then confirm by clicking Delete. If you delete your last remaining profile, Oasis will re-open with a fresh profile.

Warning

Deleting a profile permanently removes all associated data including bookmarks, passwords, browsing history, and settings. Make sure to back up any important data before deletion.

Use Sync with a new profile

You can sync data from your new profile with other devices that are signed in to your Kahana account. This allows you to access your browsing data across multiple devices and maintain consistency in your browsing experience.

Note

Oasis prevents syncing multiple profiles with the same Kahana account on the same device. If you create a new Oasis profile and then try to sign in to Sync with the same Kahana account used in the other profile on that device, Oasis will block the login to keep profiles separate.

Choose a profile at Oasis startup

To see the option to decide which profile will open when Oasis starts:

  1. 1

    In the toolbar, click the account icon.

  2. 2

    Click Manage Profiles.

  3. 3

    Select Choose a profile when Oasis opens. If this is not selected, Oasis will open to the most recently used profile.

Enterprise Profile Management

The Enterprise version of Oasis browser includes advanced profile management features designed for organizational use and IT administration.

Centralized Administration

IT administrators can centrally manage user profiles across the organization, including profile creation, deletion, and policy enforcement.

Profile Templates

Create standardized profile templates for different departments, roles, or security levels to ensure consistent configurations.

Security Policies

Apply security policies to specific profiles, including access controls, data retention policies, and compliance requirements.

Audit and Monitoring

Track profile usage, access patterns, and security events for compliance and security monitoring purposes.

Enterprise Feature

Enterprise profile management features are only available in the Oasis Enterprise Browser version. Contact your IT administrator for access to these advanced capabilities.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this feature available on mobile devices?

No, the profiles feature is currently not supported on mobile devices. Profile management is available on desktop versions of Oasis browser.

Does creating a new profile log me into an account or affect my sync settings?

No, creating or managing profiles does not sign you in to a Kahana account or change any sync settings. Sync remains separate, and profiles allow you to set up different browsing environments without linking them automatically to an account.

Will switching profiles mix my data if I'm signed in to a Kahana account?

No, switching profiles won't merge or mix your data. Each profile keeps separate browsing data, bookmarks and settings. Oasis prevents syncing multiple profiles with the same Kahana account on the same device to avoid data merging across profiles. However, each profile can connect to separate Kahana accounts.

Which profile will open when I open Oasis?

If you have selected Choose a profile when Oasis opens from the Manage Profiles screen, you will be able to choose from a list of all your profiles when Oasis opens. If this option is not selected, Oasis will open the most recently used profile.

How do data collection and privacy settings work with profiles?

Your data collection and privacy settings will apply to every Oasis profile on your device. That means you only have to change these settings in one profile, and the changes will be applied to your other profiles. When you create a new profile, your current privacy settings will automatically apply.

Should I back up my profiles?

The best way to protect your profile data is by creating a Kahana account for each profile. Sync automatically protects your data across devices, ensuring easy access whenever you need it.

What's the difference between profiles and Multi-Account Containers?

Profiles allow for complete separation of all data between each profile — including bookmarks, passwords, settings, add-ons, browsing history, and browsing data (like cookies and logins). In contrast, Multi-Account Containers only separate browsing data like cookies and logins between different containers. The Multi-Account Containers add-on can be used in a single profile, but this add-on and its containers won't be shared across profiles.

Enterprise Benefits

Enhanced Security

Separate profiles for different security contexts help maintain data isolation and reduce the risk of cross-contamination between work and personal browsing.

Improved Productivity

Dedicated profiles for different projects or clients enable focused browsing environments without distractions from other work contexts.

title: Secure Platform
description: Enterprise-grade security features and comprehensive privacy controls
content:
Kahana's secure platform provides enterprise-grade security features and comprehensive privacy controls. Our multi-layered security approach ensures your data and workflows remain protected while maintaining seamless usability.

Pro Tip

Regularly review your security settings and access logs to maintain optimal protection. Enable two-factor authentication and keep your security preferences up to date.

Key Security Features

Enhanced Content Security Policy

  • Strict HTTPS and same-origin resource loading
  • XSS attack prevention through script-src restrictions
  • Clickjacking protection via frame-ancestors control
  • Form submission security with trusted domain restrictions

Advanced Certificate Management

  • User-friendly certificate error notifications
  • Detailed certificate information display
  • Automatic validation against trusted authorities
  • Up-to-date certificate revocation checking

Security Measures

Mixed Content Protection

  • Automatic HTTP to HTTPS upgrades
  • Strict referrer policy implementation
  • Clear security notifications
  • Man-in-the-middle attack prevention

Cross-Origin Protection

  • Automatic sensitive header stripping
  • Strict same-origin policy enforcement
  • Comprehensive cross-origin policies
  • Detailed request logging

Getting Started

1

Initial Setup

Configure your security policies and access controls based on your organization's requirements.

2

Configure Monitoring

Set up security monitoring and configure alerts for potential security issues.

3

Best Practices

Follow security best practices including regular policy reviews and user education.

Enterprise Benefits

Compliance Ready

Built-in security controls support GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 compliance.

Reduced Risk

Minimized attack surface through careful API exposure control and strict security policies.

title: Troubleshooting Guide
description: Solutions for common issues and how to resolve them
content:
Troubleshooting Guide

Find solutions to common issues and learn how to optimize your Kahana experience. This guide covers performance optimization, connection issues, and general troubleshooting steps.

Common Issues

Browser Performance

If you experience slow performance:

  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Check your internet connection
  • Update your browser to the latest version
  • Disable unused extensions

Connection Issues

If you have connection problems:

  • Verify your internet connection
  • Check your firewall settings
  • Try using a different network
  • Contact your network administrator
